name: Ray of Sunlight
body:
School evocation [light]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, paladin 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one ray
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You release a bright beam of light. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to deal damage to a target. The target is blinded for 1 round and takes 2d6 points of damage. A successful Reflex save negates the blinding. Creatures harmed by sunlight and undead take 4d6 damage. Undead that are particularly adverse to sunlight, like vampires, take 6d6 damage.
